title: Write Vitest unit tests for email services
description: Write Vitest unit tests for MockEmailService, ResendEmailService, and the email factory. Mock the Resend SDK.
acceptanceCriteria: MockEmailService.send() always returns success=true with mode='mock'
Email factory returns correct service based on EMAIL_MODE setting

steps.details: Import MockEmailService, ResendEmailService, getEmailService. Mock resend package with vi.mock('resend'). Mock repository with vi.mock('../../../db/repository').
Test: send() returns { success: true, mode: 'mock' }. Test: send() does not throw even with minimal payload.

Test: factory returns MockEmailService when getSetting('email_mode') returns 'mock'. Test: factory throws when mode='live' and no API key. Test: factory returns ResendEmailService when mode='live' with key.
